findings.one_line: The headline all-parameter, evaluable universal-factor frontier remains explicitly to-prove; the delivered feasibility threshold, cover upper bound, and supported slices are a strictly weaker kernel, so the claimed theorem-level advance is not yet the promised resource law.

Related work gives no relevance sentence for the cited KocaogluDimakisVishwanath2017CostOptimal, YangKatcoffUhler2018GeneralInterventions, or ChevalleyEtAl2025CausalBench, so the bibliography is not fully targeted as required.
